title: VBM v141 engineering pre-admission, frozen before preflight
scope: Frozen v138 cell/pair architecture only, not identification of Voynich mechanism
primary_prediction: Every observed source consonant-cluster type can be given a distinct existing target cell, whose key is compatible with every observed incoming vowel for that type; no fallback or silent loss.
secondary_prediction: Every source transition with mapped next-cell key has an allowed vowel bridge for that exact key.

pass.unique_clusters: All nonempty cluster types have a distinct cell in the frozen 443-cell inventory
pass.incoming_vowel_support: Every assigned cell key is admissible for every observed incoming vowel
pass.decoder: An independent decoder must recover 100% of normalized source events and declared boundaries without side information on fresh text before any mechanism inference

controls.positive: Construct an injective, compatible assignment on the maximum matching subset; test key and inverse uniqueness assertions
controls.hard_negative: Introduce one same-key cell collision while retaining the cluster and key supports; uniqueness test must fail
controls.observational_equivalence: For any emitted stream a structural-slot transducer can emit that same stream; surface-only matches are not mechanism identification

sampling: Complete supplied v138 German-source event list, not a pooled Voynich inferential sample
null_sd: Not applicable to exact combinatorial feasibility; do not represent as statistical significance
stop: No new Voynich similarity fit or test if current v138 architecture fails the first three pass criteria; record NO-GO and an explicit proposal to revise architecture, not retrospective relaxation
limits: This gate cannot establish that no modified VBM could work
Cell admissibility is necessary, not sufficient: prefix, seam and word-boundary recoverability remain untested
The German source is also the source used to fit v138; this analysis is an architecture audit, not held-out prediction
